subject.title: [Bug]: Scheduled isolated agentTurn outer run records error although session ended success

question: Should a successful isolated cron execution with failed post-run delivery persist as `status=ok` plus `deliveryStatus=not-delivered`, or should OpenClaw introduce/use a broader warning-status contract for this partial-success state?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the observable run-status semantics affect existing operator tooling and backoff/alerting behavior, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Land the narrow status split
options.body: Use the existing status/deliveryStatus separation, land or adapt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95419, and keep the broader warning-status work separate.

options.title: Adopt warning status
options.body: Route this issue through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80139 or a replacement that updates protocol, UI, CLI, and compatibility docs for a first-class partial-success status.

options.title: Keep delivery failure as execution error
options.body: Explicitly reject the requested semantic change and close the linked fix PRs with guidance that delivery failure should continue to drive cron error state.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow status split
recommendation.body: Use the existing status/deliveryStatus separation, land or adapt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95419, and keep the broader warning-status work separate.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history trail across cron run status splitting and delivery-dispatch ownership.
